# Glossary

Domain language only — no implementation details. For format rules see the kit `domain-modeling` skill (`GLOSSARY-FORMAT.md`).

Fictional **Acme Bookings** seed terms (delete or replace):

| Term                    | Definition                                                              |
| ----------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Slot**                | A bookable interval on a studio calendar with a single capacity.        |
| **Hold**                | Temporary reservation of a slot during checkout; expires if unpaid.     |
| **Cancellation window** | Time before start when cancel is free or fee applies.                   |
| **Platform fee**        | Non-refundable fee retained by Acme on each paid booking.               |
| **Payout**              | Transfer to the studio after the booking is completed or policy allows. |

Copy to repo root `GLOSSARY.md` or `.agents/glossary.md` — pick one home and link from `AGENTS.md`. Prefer the repo's existing glossary location if one exists.
